note: Rain tyres first. This is a checklist against the current sheet — it does not silently rewrite the setup.

gearing.why: With rain tyres, add 3 or more rear teeth. Wetter = more teeth. As it dries, remove teeth.

items.label: Front track
items.targetLabel: maximum (spindle extensions if the maker has them)
items.why: Maximum front track for jacking and front bite in the wet.

items.label: Rear track
items.why: Minimum rear track for grip when the surface is slow.

items.label: Front ride height
items.why: High front ride height adds front transfer in slow corners.

items.label: Caster
items.why: Slow corners make inside-rear lift harder. Extra caster increases jacking and front grip.

items.label: Axle
items.why: Medium axle is the wet starting point when you have time to swap.

items.label: Torsion bars
items.why: Remove torsion bars in the wet.

items.label: Front torsion bar
items.why: Remove torsion bars in the wet.

items.label: Seat height
items.targetLabel: rear ~25 mm higher (or a folded towel)
items.why: A slightly higher seat helps load the outside in the wet.

items.label: Rear ride height
items.why: Maximum rear ride height for wet grip.

paddockReminders: Shield the rear rotor (number panel ahead of the caliper).
Airbox water deflector only if class-legal.
Drive off the oily rubbered line. Confirm class regs before changing anything marked homologated.
